title: Chapupu Chakasimba
intro: Nyaya yakadzama inobuda pachena, ichiratidza kutsunga kusingazununguki kwenharaunda mukutarisana nehudzvinyiriri hukuru. Nyaya yavo inoshanda seuchapupu hwekutenda, kunyangwe kana vakatarisana nechibayiro chikuru. Nyaya iyi inotiyeuchidza nezvesimba rekutenda pakurwisa kudzvinyirirwa kukuru.
clues: Taiva boka rine nyaya yaro inorondedzerwa musurah pfupi, ine simba, ichinyevera nezvekutambudzwa.
Takatarisana nemutongi aida kubvisa kutenda kwedu muna Mwari Mumwe chete, Ishe weChigaro, Anofanira Kurumbidzwa.
Takaedzwa zvikuru negomba guru rakacherwa muvhu.
Takatarisa vatendi, kusanganisira vacheche, vachikandwa mumoto unotyisa mukati megomba iroro.
Vatambudzi vedu vakatukwa nekuda kwezviito zvavo, ukuwo isu takavimbiswa mubairo mukuru nekuda kwekutsungirira kwedu.
Kuedza kwemutongi kudzima kutenda kwedu kwakasimbisa nzvimbo yedu sevaya vakafa pamberi paAllah, uyo ari chapupu chezvinhu zvose.
arabic: وَمَا نَقَمُوا۟ مِنْهُمْ إِلَّآ أَن يُؤْمِنُوا۟ بِٱللَّهِ ٱلْعَزِيزِ ٱلْحَمِيدِ
verse: And they resented them not except because they believed in Allāh, the Exalted in Might, the Praiseworthy, (85:8)
